what: Real /archive-mail runs against Apple Mail in scratch copies of one existing workspace (config, index, threads, archived md). Mail was only read; the real workspace was not modified. Addresses are replaced by placeholders (P1, P2 = two sender addresses; G = the maintainer's own address).

sop_versions.B, C: PR #445 at 07744e0 (first runs, kept as history)
sop_versions.B2, C2: PR #445 at 229555e (final SOP text; the acceptance runs)

run_A_vs_B_no_identity_file.coverage_audit: 12 of 12 threads complete in both; attachments 0/0 in both
run_A_vs_B_no_identity_file.caveat: this workspace has no participant_aliases, writes all four routing lists, and the new mail had no attachments, so the new alias and routing rules were not exercised by A/B; run C exercises them

run_C_temporary_identity_file.identity_file: created by the coordinator for this run only (P1, P2 and one address used nowhere else), read-only during the run, deleted afterwards; the path is fixed, so the real file was used for about 18 minutes; any other /archive-mail run in that window would have read it (none known)
